about_the_game:
The game supports one-click mod installation.

(Requires accessing a third-party website via a one-click link for download)

The story begins in a castle occupied by demons.The goddesses are imprisoned here...Our protagonist, PaiPai, wakes up in the demons' prison.She needs to escape from here and end the demons' control over the goddesses!

This is a game that combines high-density enemy groups, side-scrolling action-adventure, and dungeon exploration.It is also an arcade-style game where the same levels can be replayed repeatedly.

The game has a total of 5 levels, and you will face a huge number of enemies!Choosing a reasonable way to eliminate them is a very important strategy~

Initially, you have 3 abilities:

  • Shock Wave: This skill is not very stable! But it can be continuously upgraded to increase attack power and attack range!

  • Blink: You can blink at any time to avoid damage and reach some hard-to-access places! However, Blink has a cooldown time and cannot be used multiple times in a short period!

  • Flight: The most important skill in the game! You can activate Light Shield while flying!

The gold coins you obtain in the game can be used to unlock and upgrade magic~You can attack the loot dropped by enemies to get more gold coins~

There are 4 types of magic in the game waiting for you to unlock:

  • Ice Surge: Extremely fast firing speed.

  • Fire Surge: Wide attack range.

  • Quantum Barrage: Strong penetration.

  • Light Shield: It can not only act as a shield to protect you! It can also instantly kill enemies! Using it reasonably can deal high damage to bosses!

Finally, let's unite together~! Let's help our protagonist escape from here!

Thanks to the lovely voice actors~
Naoka Nakayama 中山尚華

ona Fujita  藤田伊緒奈

Rio Tokura 柚木提娜

Manoa Ueda 上田真乃彩

Reika Morimoto 森本丽香

content_descriptors.notes: Exposed clothing, breast shake, does not include sexual activity
